CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_neroxa_public_contract(p_token uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_contract public.neroxa_contracts%rowtype;
  v_client public.neroxa_organizations%rowtype;
begin
  select * into v_contract
  from public.neroxa_contracts
  where public_signature_token = p_token
    and signature_status in ('PENDING_CUSTOMER','PENDING_NEROXA','SIGNED')
  limit 1;

  if not found then raise exception 'Contrato não encontrado, indisponível ou já encerrado'; end if;

  select * into v_client from public.neroxa_organizations where id = v_contract.client_id limit 1;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'id', v_contract.id,
    'contract_number', v_contract.contract_number,
    'title', v_contract.title,
    'status', v_contract.status,
    'signature_status', v_contract.signature_status,
    'version', v_contract.version,
    'commercial_model', v_contract.commercial_model,
    'billing_period', v_contract.billing_period,
    'recurring_value', v_contract.recurring_value,
    'setup_value', v_contract.setup_value,
    'maintenance_value', v_contract.maintenance_value,
    'currency', v_contract.currency,
    'issued_at', v_contract.issued_at,
    'term_months', v_contract.term_months,
    'started_at', v_contract.started_at,
    'customer_name', coalesce(v_client.trade_name, v_client.legal_name),

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_neroxa_public_proposal(p_token uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  result jsonb;
begin
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'id', p.id,
    'title', p.title,
    'status', p.status,
    'notes', p.notes,
    'valid_until', p.valid_until,
    'sent_at', p.sent_at,
    'accepted_at', p.accepted_at,
    'rejected_at', p.rejected_at,
    'commercial_model', p.commercial_model,
    'billing_period', p.billing_period,
    'recurring_value', p.recurring_value,
    'setup_value', p.setup_value,
    'maintenance_value', p.maintenance_value,
    'currency', p.currency,
    'version', p.version,
    'client_name', coalesce(c.trade_name, c.legal_name, 'Cliente'),
    'plan_name', pl.name,
    'system_name', s.name
  )
  into result
  from public.neroxa_proposals p
  left join public.neroxa_organizations o on o.id = p.client_id
  left join public.neroxa_clients c on c.organization_id = o.id
  left join public.neroxa_plans pl on pl.id = p.plan_id
  left join public.neroxa_systems s on s.id = p.system_id
  where p.public_token = p_token
    and p.status in ('SENT','NEGOTIATION','ACCEPTED');

  return result;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_public_order_status(p_order_id uuid, p_customer_phone text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_order public.neroxa_orders; v_items jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_order from public.neroxa_orders
  where id=p_order_id and regexp_replace(customer_phone,'\\D','','g')=regexp_replace(trim(p_customer_phone),'\\D','','g');
  if not found then return null; end if;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'lineId', i.id::text, 'productId', i.product_id, 'productName', i.product_name,
    'imageUrl', i.product_image_url, 'secondProductId', i.second_product_id,
    'secondProductName', i.second_product_name, 'isHalf', i.is_half,
    'sizeId', i.size_id, 'sizeName', i.size_name, 'crustId', i.crust_id, 'crustName', i.crust_name,
    'crustPrice', i.crust_price, 'addons', i.addons, 'complements', i.complements,
    'quantity', i.quantity, 'notes', i.notes, 'unitPrice', i.unit_price
  ) order by i.created_at), '[]'::jsonb) into v_items
  from public.neroxa_order_items i where i.order_id=v_order.id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'id',v_order.id,'order_id',v_order.id,'order_number',v_order.order_number,
    'status',v_order.status,'customer_name',v_order.customer_name,'customer_phone',v_order.customer_phone,
    'fulfillment',v_order.fulfillment,'payment_method',v_order.payment_method,
    'subtotal',v_order.subtotal,'delivery_fee',v_order.delivery_fee,'total',v_order.total,
    'address_street',v_order.address_street,'address_number',v_order.address_number,
    'address_neighborhood',v_order.address_neighborhood,'address_complement',v_order.address_complement,
    'address_reference',v_order.address_reference,'notes',v_order.notes,'items',v_items,
    'created_at',v_order.created_at,'updated_at',v_order.updated_at
  );
end;

      'name', coalesce(o.trade_name, o.legal_name, 'Sua empresa')
    ),
    'instance', case when i.id is null then null else jsonb_build_object(
      'id', i.id,
      'name', i.name,
      'slug', i.slug,
      'status', i.status,
      'system_type', i.system_type
    ) end,
    'subscription', case when s.id is null then null else jsonb_build_object(
      'id', s.id,
      'status', s.status,
      'plan_id', s.plan_id
    ) end,
    'plan', case when p.id is null then null else jsonb_build_object(
      'id', p.id,
      'name', p.name,
      'slug', p.slug
    ) end,
    'modules', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'key', replace(f.feature_key, 'module_', ''),
          'enabled', f.enabled,
          'limit_value', f.limit_value
        )
        order by f.feature_key
      )
      from public.neroxa_plan_features f
      where f.plan_id = p.id
        and f.feature_key like 'module_%'
        and f.enabled = true
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  into result
  from public.neroxa_organization_members m
  join public.neroxa_organizations o on o.id = m.organization_id
  left join lateral (
    select i.*
    from public.neroxa_system_instances i
    where i.organization_id = m.organization_id
      and i.status <> 'ARCHIVED'
    order by i.created_at desc
    limit 1
  ) i on true
  left join public.neroxa_subscriptions s on s.id = i.subscription_id
  left join public.neroxa_plans p on p.id = coalesce(s.plan_id, i.plan_id)
  where m.user_id = auth.uid()
    and m.active = true
    and o.active = true
    and (s.id is null or s.status in ('ACTIVE','TRIALING','PAST_DUE'))
  order by
    case m.role when 'OWNER' then 1 when 'ADMIN' then 2 when 'MANAGER' then 3 else 4 end,
    m.created_at
  limit 1;

  return coalesce(result, jsonb_build_object(
    'organization_id', null,
    'role', null,
    'organization', null,
    'instance', null,
    'subscription', null,
    'plan', null,
    'modules', '[]'::jsonb
  ));
end;
$function$

functions.name: sync_neroxa_contract_terminal_lifecycle

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_neroxa_contract_terminal_lifecycle()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_subscription record;
begin
  if new.status in ('TERMINATED','EXPIRED') and old.status is distinct from new.status then
    for v_subscription in
      select id, organization_id, status
      from public.neroxa_subscriptions
      where contract_id = new.id
        and status in ('TRIAL','ACTIVE','PAUSED','PAST_DUE')
      for update
    loop
      update public.neroxa_subscriptions
      set status = 'CANCELLED',
          cancelled_at = coalesce(cancelled_at, now()),
          updated_at = now()
      where id = v_subscription.id;

      insert into public.neroxa_audit_logs (
        actor_id,
        organization_id,
        action,
        resource_type,
        resource_id,
        details
      )
      values (
        auth.uid(),
        v_subscription.organization_id,
        'SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS_CHANGED',
        'SUBSCRIPTION',
        v_subscription.id,
        jsonb_build_object(
          'status', 'CANCELLED',
          'previousStatus', v_subscription.status,
          'reason', 'CONTRACT_TERMINAL_LIFECYCLE',
          'contractId', new.id,
          'contractStatus', new.status
        )
      );
    end loop;

    update public.neroxa_billing_records b
    set status = 'CANCELLED'
    where b.subscription_id in (
      select s.id
      from public.neroxa_subscriptions s
      where s.contract_id = new.id
    )
      and b.status = 'PENDING';
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

functions.name: sync_neroxa_instance_from_provisioning_job

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_neroxa_instance_from_provisioning_job()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_latest_status public.neroxa_provisioning_status;
begin
  if new.system_instance_id is null then
    return new;
  end if;

  select status
    into v_latest_status
    from public.neroxa_provisioning_jobs
   where system_instance_id = new.system_instance_id
   order by created_at desc, id desc
   limit 1;

  if v_latest_status = 'COMPLETED' then
    update public.neroxa_system_instances
       set status = 'ACTIVE',
           updated_at = now()
     where id = new.system_instance_id
       and status not in ('ARCHIVED', 'SUSPENDED');
  else
    update public.neroxa_system_instances
       set status = 'PROVISIONING',
           updated_at = now()
     where id = new.system_instance_id
       and status not in ('ARCHIVED', 'SUSPENDED');
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$
